process_steps.description: Primary recovery: continuous disk-stack centrifugation followed by depth and sterile filtration; clarifies the culture and defines the feed to Protein A. Forms no product-quality attribute.

statements.statement_text: The clarification step yield is 97.7% at the nominal condition.
The post-clarification turbidity is within its normal operating range, confirming a consistent feed to Protein A.
The characterization confirms that harvest and clarification has no product-quality impact.
Centrifugation force and depth-filter load are KPP; post-clarification turbidity is a monitored GPP.
This report rolls up into the Process Characterization Master Report (PCMR-001).
